# Tools: Repository links and code index

### `list_project_repository_links` [A] · read · portfolio:read · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: List the GitHub read-only repository links attached to one project (active links only, unless includeArchived is true).
Use when: You need a project repositoryLinkId for scan_project_repository_readonly, update_project_repository_link or archive_project_repository_link; You want to see every repository a project points to, including links hidden from agents (agentVisible=false); You want lastScanAt / lastScanStatus / lastKnownCommit before deciding whether to re-scan    Avoid when: You need the latest scan summaries for agent context: use get_project_repository_context; You need an id for code search, index status, commit comparison or index admin: use list_workspace_repository_links (code intelligence runs only on workspace links)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id) | Firestore document id |
| includeArchived | no | constant | boolean, default false; true also returns archived links (archivedAt set) |
Preconditions: Project exists; Caller can read the project (project owner, governance role, workspace owner/active member, or team member)
Returns: Array sorted by updatedAt desc. Each link: id (= repositoryLinkId), canonicalRepositoryUrl, owner, repo, defaultBranch, allowedBranches, agentVisible, analysisPolicy, repositoryRole, componentName, submodulePath, relationship, automatedScanPolicy{enabled, intervalHours}, visibility, lastKnownCommit, lastScanAt, lastScanStatus (never_scanned|completed|failed|rate_limited), archivedAt, credentialOwnerId.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Project <id> not found | Get a valid projectId from list_projects. |
| You do not have access to this project | Caller has no read access. Do not retry; tell the user. |
| JSON-RPC -32003 (tool not allowed for this API key profile or OAuth scope portfolio:read missing) | Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user which scope or key profile to enable. |
Gotchas:
- Also returns agent-hidden links (get_project_repository_context does not).
- Project link ids are rejected by get_repository_index_status, search tools and compare_repository_commits; only read_repository_file_excerpt maps a project link id to the workspace link of the same repository.
Pairs with: `list_projects`, `scan_project_repository_readonly`, `get_project_repository_context`, `update_project_repository_link`
CLI: `lpm project-repos list --project <projectId> [--include-archived] [--json]`

### `create_project_repository_link` [C] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Attach a GitHub repository (read-only) to one project so it can be scanned for metadata and shown to agents.
Use when: The user asks to link a GitHub repository to a specific project; A project has no repository link and the user confirmed which repository (and branch) to use    Avoid when: The repository is already linked to the project (check list_project_repository_links first): use update_project_repository_link; You need code search, code index or exact excerpts for the repository: use create_workspace_repository_link with projectMappings (project links are never code-indexed); One repository serves several projects (umbrella/monorepo): use create_workspace_repository_link with projectMappings
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id | Project must belong to a workspace |
| repositoryUrl | yes | user | Exactly https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> (a trailing .git is stripped). No query, fragment, credentials, IP or non-github.com host. Stored lowercased as canonicalRepositoryUrl |
| defaultBranch | no | user | Branch name; omitted = repository default branch discovered by the scan |
| allowedBranches | no | user | Array of branch names matching [A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,200}; invalid entries are silently dropped; empty = any branch |
| agentVisible | no | constant | boolean, default true; false hides the link from get_project_repository_context and automated scans |
| analysisPolicy | no | constant | metadata_only (default) \| shallow_tree (adds top-level tree and up to 8 manifest summaries, depth <= 2). full_scan is rejected |
| repositoryRole | no | user | primary (default) \| umbrella \| component \| infra \| docs \| legacy |
| componentName | no | user | free text |
| submodulePath | no | user | relative path [A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,300}; no leading / and no .. |
| relationship | no | user | implements \| composes \| supports \| deploys \| documents \| observes |
| automatedScanEnabled | no | user | boolean, default false; true lets the scheduler re-scan automatically with the creator's stored personal GitHub credential |
| automatedScanIntervalHours | no | user | integer 1..168, default 24 |
Preconditions: Project exists and belongs to a workspace; Caller can manage the project (project owner, project-owner governance role, workspace owner/admin, or team manager); No active link to the same canonical URL exists in this project; User asked for or confirmed the link
Returns: The new link: id (use as repositoryLinkId), canonicalRepositoryUrl, owner, repo, lastScanStatus='never_scanned', visibility='unknown', credentialOwnerId (= caller), automatedScanPolicy.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| An active project repository link already exists for this repository. | Do not retry. Get its id from list_project_repository_links; use update_project_repository_link if something must change. |
| Project repository URL must ... (have the shape https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> / use https / host must be github.com / not include query strings or fragments / not include credentials) | Ask the user for the plain https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> URL. |
| Project repository links require the project to belong to a workspace. | Stop; the project has no workspace. Tell the user. |
| You do not have permission to manage this project | Ask a project owner or workspace owner/admin to do it. |
| Project repository automated scan interval must be an integer from 1 to 168 hours. | Send an integer 1..168 or omit it (default 24). |
| Invalid project repository analysis policy / role / relationship, or full_scan is disabled | Use only the enum values listed in inputs. |
Gotchas:
- The caller becomes credentialOwnerId: private-repository scans (manual and automated) fall back to the caller's personal GitHub credential.
- Creating does not scan; call scan_project_repository_readonly next.
- Audited (project_repository_link_created).
- API key only (not in OAuth connectors).
Pairs with: `list_project_repository_links`, `scan_project_repository_readonly`, `get_project_repository_context`
CLI: `lpm project-repos create --project <projectId> --url <github-url> [--branch <branch>] [--allowed-branches <b1; b2>] [--analysis-policy <metadata_only|shallow_tree>] [--role <primary|umbrella|component|infra|docs|legacy>] [--component <name>] [--submodule-path <path>] [--relationship <implements|composes|supports|deploys|documents|observes>] [--automated-scan-enabled] [--automated-scan-interval-hours <1..168>] [--agent-hidden] [--json]`

### `update_project_repository_link` [C] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Change the settings of an active (non-archived) project repository link; only the fields you send change.
Use when: The user asks to change branch, allowed branches, analysis policy, role, component, relationship or automated-scan settings of a project link; The user asks to hide a link from agents (agentVisible=false) or show it again    Avoid when: The link is archived: create a new one with create_project_repository_link; Removing the link: use archive_project_repository_link; Workspace-level links: use update_workspace_repository_link
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id | Must be the project that owns the link |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_project_repository_links -> id | Project link id |
| repositoryUrl | no | user | https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>. Changing it resets visibility, lastKnownCommit, lastScanAt, lastScanStatus=never_scanned and sets credentialOwnerId to the caller |
| defaultBranch | no | user | Empty string clears it |
| allowedBranches | no | user | Replaces the whole list; [] clears it (any branch allowed) |
| agentVisible | no | user | boolean |
| analysisPolicy | no | constant | metadata_only \| shallow_tree |
| repositoryRole | no | user | primary \| umbrella \| component \| infra \| docs \| legacy |
| componentName | no | user | free text; empty string clears |
| submodulePath | no | user | relative path, no leading / and no .. |
| relationship | no | user | implements \| composes \| supports \| deploys \| documents \| observes |
| automatedScanEnabled | no | user | boolean; if omitted while the interval is sent, the previous value is kept |
| automatedScanIntervalHours | no | user | integer 1..168 |
Preconditions: Link exists in this project and is not archived; Caller can manage the project; At least one field besides the ids is sent; User asked for or confirmed the change
Returns: The full updated link (previous fields merged with the patch), including id, agentVisible, automatedScanPolicy, lastScanStatus.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Project repository link not found. | Re-read ids with list_project_repository_links for this projectId. |
| Archived project repository links cannot be edited. | Create a new link with create_project_repository_link (after user confirmation). |
| Project repository link update has no changes. | Send at least one field to change. |
| You do not have permission to manage this project | Ask a project owner or workspace owner/admin. |
| URL / enum / interval validation messages (same as create_project_repository_link) | Fix the value using the input notes. |
Gotchas:
- No optimistic-concurrency check: last write wins.
- Every call writes an audit event.
- Changing settings does not trigger a scan.
Pairs with: `list_project_repository_links`, `scan_project_repository_readonly`
CLI: `lpm project-repos update --project <projectId> --link <repositoryLinkId> [--url <github-url>] [--branch <branch>] [--allowed-branches <b1; b2>] [--analysis-policy <metadata_only|shallow_tree>] [--role <role>] [--component <name>] [--submodule-path <path>] [--relationship <relationship>] [--automated-scan-enabled|--automated-scan-disabled] [--automated-scan-interval-hours <1..168>] [--agent-visible|--agent-hidden] [--json]`

### `archive_project_repository_link` [C] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Archive (soft-remove) a project repository link with a reason so it is no longer scanned, edited or shown to agents.
Use when: The user asks to remove or unlink a repository from a project; A link points to a wrong or retired repository and the user confirmed removal    Avoid when: You only want to hide it temporarily: update_project_repository_link with agentVisible=false (reversible); Workspace-level link: archive_workspace_repository_link
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id | Project that owns the link |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_project_repository_links -> id | Project link id |
| reason | yes | user | Non-empty text explaining why |
Preconditions: Link exists in this project; Caller can manage the project; User explicitly confirmed the archive
Returns: The link with archivedAt, archivedBy, archiveReason set (an already archived link is returned unchanged).
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Project repository archive requires a reason. | Send a non-empty reason. |

### `scan_project_repository_readonly` [A] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Read GitHub metadata (branch head commit, languages, default branch, optional shallow tree and manifests) for a project link and store a scan summary.
Use when: The latest scan is missing, failed, or older than 24 h (stale) and you need current repository facts; Before stating anything about the repository's current branch, commit or languages; Right after create_project_repository_link    Avoid when: You need code content or symbol search: use search_project_code / read_repository_file_excerpt (they read the code index, not scans); A scan younger than 24 h exists: read it with get_project_repository_context; Workspace-level links: use scan_workspace_repository_readonly
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id | Project that owns the link |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_project_repository_links -> id | Project link id |
| branch | no | user or list_project_repository_links -> defaultBranch | Must be in allowedBranches when that list is non-empty; default = link defaultBranch, then repository default |
| credentialSource | no | constant | default (or omit) \| workspace. 'workspace' uses the workspace GitHub vault; send it only when a workspace owner/admin explicitly asks. Refused for owner-agent credentials |
Preconditions: Link exists in this project and is not archived; Caller can manage the project (scanning needs manage, not read); Workspace used fewer than 10 scans in the last hour (project, workspace and automated scans share this limit); Private repository: the link's credential owner has a personal GitHub credential, or the GitHub App connector is configured, or credentialSource=workspace with a configured vault
Returns: Scan summary: id, status='completed', branch, commitSha (full SHA), visibility (public|private), scannedAt, metadata{description, language, languages, topics, defaultBranch, license, readmePresent}, tree (shallow_tree only: totalEntries, truncated, topLevel[], manifests[{path, summary}]), credentialSource, requestCount. Also updates the link's lastKnownCommit, lastScanAt, lastScanStatus.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Project repository scan rate limit exceeded: max 10 scans per workspace hour. | Stop. Wait up to one hour; never retry in a loop. |
| Requested branch is not allowed for this repository link. | Omit branch or use one listed in allowedBranches. |
| Private or non-public GitHub repositories require a user GitHub credential with read access or a configured read-only GitHub App connector ... | Tell the user: the link owner must configure a personal GitHub credential, or the GitHub App must be installed; a workspace owner/admin may instead rerun with credentialSource=workspace. |
| Private GitHub repository scan failed. Verify the linked user GitHub credential or the read-only GitHub App installation ... | The configured credential or App lacks access to this repository; report to the user. |
| Workspace credential access requires an explicit manager scan. | You are using an owner-agent credential; omit credentialSource. |
| Workspace GitHub credential unavailable or access denied. | Check get_workspace_repository_credential (configured=true) and that the caller is workspace owner/admin; otherwise omit credentialSource. |
| GitHub branch commit SHA could not be resolved. | The branch does not exist; omit branch to use the default. |
| Archived project repository links cannot be scanned. | Use an active link from list_project_repository_links. |
Gotchas:
- A failed scan is still stored (status failed or rate_limited), updates lastScanStatus and counts toward the 10/hour limit, then the call returns an error.
- Limits per scan: 30 s, 30 GitHub requests, 5 MB.
- The tool description says 'public' but private repositories work with a credential.
- A scan never refreshes the code index.
- Manifest summaries redact emails and key=value secrets.
- Owner-agent credentials cannot use stored personal or workspace GitHub credentials (public repos or GitHub App only).
Pairs with: `list_project_repository_links`, `get_project_repository_context`
CLI: `lpm project-repos scan --project <projectId> --link <repositoryLinkId> [--branch <branch>] [--credential-source <default|workspace>] [--json]`

Purpose: List the workspace-level GitHub read-only repository links (the links that carry code indexes and project mappings).
Use when: You need a workspace repositoryLinkId for get_repository_index_status, read_repository_file_excerpt, compare_repository_commits or any code-index admin tool; You want to see which projects (and folders) a shared or umbrella repository is mapped to (projectMappings); search_project_code returned no results and you want to check whether the project is mapped    Avoid when: Project-scoped links: list_project_repository_links; You also need the latest scan summaries: get_workspace_repository_context

Returns: Array sorted by updatedAt desc. ### `create_workspace_repository_link` [C] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Attach a GitHub repository at workspace level (shared or umbrella context) and map it to projects so it can be code-indexed and searched.
Use when: The user wants code search or Advisor code evidence for a repository; One repository serves several projects (umbrella/monorepo) and the user said which folder belongs to which project; A workspace owner/admin asked to register a repository for the workspace    Avoid when: The repository already has an active workspace link (check list_workspace_repository_links): use update_workspace_repository_link; Only metadata scans for a single project are needed: create_project_repository_link
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryUrl | yes | user | Exactly https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>; no query, fragment, credentials or other host |
| defaultBranch | no | user | Branch used for scans and indexing; omitted = repository default |
| allowedBranches | no | user | Array of branch names; empty = any |
| agentVisible | no | constant | boolean, default true; false blocks all code tools for this repository |
| analysisPolicy | no | constant | metadata_only (default) \| shallow_tree |
| repositoryRole | no | user | primary (default) \| umbrella \| component \| infra \| docs \| legacy |
| componentName | no | user | free text |
| submodulePath | no | user | relative path, no leading / and no .. |
| relationship | no | user | implements \| composes \| supports \| deploys \| documents \| observes |
| projectMappings | no | user + list_workspace_projects -> id | Array (max 50; extra entries silently dropped) of {projectId (required, 6-80 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-], project of THIS workspace, no duplicates), repositoryPath (relative folder, no leading / or ..), componentName, relationship (enum above), agentVisible (default true)}. search_project_code only sees projects listed here |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin; API key with full or custom profile (sensitive admin tool); Every mapped project belongs to this workspace; No active workspace link to the same canonical URL; User asked for or confirmed the link
Returns: The new link: id (repositoryLinkId for all code tools), canonicalRepositoryUrl, projectMappings (normalized), credentialOwnerId (= caller), lastScanStatus='never_scanned'.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap (may arrive as JSON-RPC -32003) | Caller must be workspace owner/admin; tell the user. |
| Workspace repository project mapping references project outside workspace: <id>. | Use projectIds from list_workspace_projects for this workspace. |
| Workspace repository project mapping requires a valid projectId. / ... duplicates projectId <id>. | Fix projectMappings: one entry per valid projectId. |
| An active workspace repository link already exists for this repository. | Get the id from list_workspace_repository_links and use update_workspace_repository_link. |
| Project repository URL must ... (shape/https/github.com/no query/no credentials) | Ask the user for the plain https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> URL. |
Gotchas:
- Creating the link does not index it: code search works only after refresh_repository_code_index + activate_repository_code_index (or an automatic GitHub-push or daily maintenance run).
- The caller becomes credentialOwnerId; without the GitHub App connector, private-repository indexing uses the caller's personal GitHub credential.
- Workspace link mutations are sensitive admin tools: only full/custom API keys see them.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_repository_links`, `scan_workspace_repository_readonly`, `preview_repository_code_index`, `refresh_repository_code_index`, `activate_repository_code_index`
CLI: `lpm workspace-repos create --workspace <workspaceId> --url <github-url> [--branch <branch>] [--allowed-branches <b1; b2>] [--analysis-policy <metadata_only|shallow_tree>] [--role <role>] [--component <name>] [--submodule-path <path>] [--relationship <relationship>] [--project-mapping <projectId:path:component:relationship; ...>] [--agent-hidden] [--json]`

### `update_workspace_repository_link` [C] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Change the settings or project mappings of an active workspace repository link.
Use when: The user asks to add or remove a project mapping, or change the folder (repositoryPath) a project owns in an umbrella repository; The user asks to change default/allowed branches, analysis policy, role or agent visibility; search_project_code returns the omission 'No authorized active repository link is mapped to this scope' and the user confirms the repository belongs to that project    Avoid when: The link is archived: create_workspace_repository_link; Removing the repository: archive_workspace_repository_link; Project-scoped link: update_project_repository_link
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Workspace link id |
| projectMappings | no | list_workspace_repository_links -> projectMappings (+ user changes) | REPLACES the whole array: send every mapping you want to keep; [] removes all. Same item rules as create_workspace_repository_link |
| repositoryUrl | no | user | Changing it resets scan state and makes the caller credentialOwnerId |
| defaultBranch | no | user | Empty string clears it |
| allowedBranches | no | user | Replaces the whole list |
| agentVisible | no | user | false removes the repository from all code tools immediately |
| analysisPolicy | no | constant | metadata_only \| shallow_tree |
| repositoryRole | no | user | primary \| umbrella \| component \| infra \| docs \| legacy |
| componentName | no | user | free text |
| submodulePath | no | user | relative path |
| relationship | no | user | implements \| composes \| supports \| deploys \| documents \| observes |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); Link exists and is not archived; Mapped projects belong to the workspace; User asked for or confirmed the change
Returns: The full updated link, including projectMappings.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Workspace repository link not found. | Re-read ids with list_workspace_repository_links. |
| Archived workspace repository links cannot be edited. | Create a new link (after user confirmation). |
| Workspace repository link update has no changes. | Send at least one field to change. |
| Workspace repository project mapping references project outside workspace / requires a valid projectId / duplicates projectId | Fix projectMappings with ids from list_workspace_projects. |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Caller must be workspace owner/admin. |
Gotchas:
- No concurrency check (last write wins).
- Mapping changes affect search_project_code immediately; no re-index needed (folder filtering happens at query time).
- Forgetting existing mappings in projectMappings silently unmaps those projects.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_repository_links`, `search_project_code`, `reconcile_workspace_code_indexes`
CLI: `lpm workspace-repos update --workspace <workspaceId> --link <repositoryLinkId> [--url <github-url>] [--branch <branch>] [--allowed-branches <b1; b2>] [--analysis-policy <metadata_only|shallow_tree>] [--role <role>] [--component <name>] [--submodule-path <path>] [--relationship <relationship>] [--project-mapping <projectId:path:component:relationship; ...>] [--clear-project-mappings] [--agent-visible|--agent-hidden] [--json]`

### `archive_workspace_repository_link` [C] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Archive a workspace repository link with a reason; its code index becomes unreachable for search, excerpts and index tools.
Use when: The user asks to remove a repository from the workspace; The repository is retired and the user confirmed removal    Avoid when: Temporary hiding: update_workspace_repository_link with agentVisible=false; Project-scoped link: archive_project_repository_link
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Workspace link id |
| reason | yes | user | Non-empty text |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); Link exists; User explicitly confirmed the archive
Returns: The link with archivedAt, archivedBy, archiveReason set (an already archived link is returned unchanged).
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Project repository archive requires a reason. (same message for workspace links) | Send a non-empty reason. |
| Workspace repository link not found. | Re-read ids with list_workspace_repository_links. |

Gotchas:
- No unarchive; an archived link cannot be edited, scanned, searched or indexed.
- Re-linking creates a new id with no index (refresh + activate needed again).

CLI: `lpm workspace-repos archive --workspace <workspaceId> --link <repositoryLinkId> --reason <text> --confirm [--json]`

### `scan_workspace_repository_readonly` [A] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Read GitHub metadata (branch head commit, languages, default branch, optional shallow tree and manifests) for a workspace link and store a scan summary.
Use when: The workspace link's latest scan is missing, failed, or older than 24 h and you need current repository facts; Right after create_workspace_repository_link; A workspace owner/admin asks to verify access to a private repository with the workspace vault (credentialSource=workspace)    Avoid when: You need code content: search_workspace_code / read_repository_file_excerpt; You want to know whether the code index is current: reconcile_workspace_code_indexes (scans never refresh the index); Project-scoped links: scan_project_repository_readonly

Returns: Scan summary: id, status='completed', branch, commitSha, visibility, scannedAt, metadata{description, language, languages, topics, defaultBranch, license, readmePresent}, tree (shallow_tree only), credentialSource. Updates the link's lastKnownCommit, lastScanAt, lastScanStatus.

|---|---|
| Project repository scan rate limit exceeded: max 10 scans per workspace hour. | Stop. Wait up to one hour; never retry in a loop. |
| Requested branch is not allowed for this repository link. | Omit branch or use one from allowedBranches. |
| Private or non-public GitHub repositories require ... / Private GitHub repository scan failed ... | No credential with access; tell the user (personal GitHub credential, GitHub App, or a manager scan with credentialSource=workspace). |
| Workspace credential access requires an explicit manager scan. | Owner-agent credential in use; omit credentialSource. |
| Workspace GitHub credential unavailable or access denied. / Workspace GitHub repository scan failed. Check repository access and retry. | Check get_workspace_repository_credential; the vault token may lack access to this repository. Report to the user. |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Caller must be workspace owner/admin. |
| Archived workspace repository links cannot be scanned. | Use an active link. |
Gotchas:
- Failed scans are stored, update lastScanStatus and consume the 10/hour budget before the error is returned.
- Limits: 30 s, 30 GitHub requests, 5 MB.
- With credentialSource=workspace, GitHub error details are hidden behind a generic message.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_repository_links`, `get_workspace_repository_context`, `reconcile_workspace_code_indexes`
CLI: `lpm workspace-repos scan --workspace <workspaceId> --link <repositoryLinkId> [--branch <branch>] [--credential-source <default|workspace>] [--json]`

### `get_repository_index_status` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Show the code-index pointer (active and previous version, indexed commit, generation) for one workspace repository link.
Use when: Before searching, to confirm the repository has an active index and which commit it covers; To get expectedGeneration for activate_repository_code_index or rollback_repository_code_index; Explaining an Advisor codeEvidence.status of no_active_index    Avoid when: Checking freshness of all repositories against GitHub: reconcile_workspace_code_indexes; You only have a project link id: get the workspace link id from list_workspace_repository_links first
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Must be a workspace link id; project link ids fail |
Preconditions: Caller can read the workspace; Workspace link exists, is not archived and agentVisible is not false
Returns: {workspaceId, repositoryLinkId, pointer: null (never indexed) or {activeIndexVersionId, previousIndexVersionId, expectedRepositoryCommitSha, generation, updatedAt, lastReconciledAt}, versions[{id, branch, commitSha, status (active|superseded|validating|failed), documentCount (files), searchableChunkCount, excludedFileCount, createdAt, validatedAt, activatedAt, failureReason}], generatedAt}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Workspace repository link not found | You passed a project link id or the wrong workspace; use list_workspace_repository_links. |
| Workspace repository link is not available for code intelligence | The link is archived or agent-hidden; tell the user. |
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Check workspaceId and membership. |
Gotchas:
- Use expectedGeneration 0 when pointer is null.
- Only the active and previous versions are listed; a candidate just built by refresh_repository_code_index (status validating) is NOT shown, so keep the id that refresh returned.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_repository_links`, `search_workspace_code`, `activate_repository_code_index`, `rollback_repository_code_index`
CLI: `lpm code-index status --workspace <workspaceId> --link <repositoryLinkId> [--json]`

### `compare_repository_commits` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Compare two full commit SHAs of a workspace repository on GitHub and list the changed files (max 100).
Use when: Explaining what changed between the indexed commit and the current branch head before deciding to refresh the index; The user gives two commits (e.g., two releases) and asks which files changed    Avoid when: You need file contents: read_repository_file_excerpt; You only have branch names or short SHAs: get full SHAs from get_repository_index_status, reconcile_workspace_code_indexes or a scan result first
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Workspace link id only; project link ids fail |
| baseCommitSha | yes | get_repository_index_status -> pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha, or user | Full 40-hex SHA |
| headCommitSha | yes | reconcile_workspace_code_indexes -> results[].repositoryCommitSha, scan -> commitSha, or user | Full 40-hex SHA |
Preconditions: Caller can read the workspace; Workspace link is not archived and is agent-visible; GitHub access to the repository (GitHub App, or the link creator's personal GitHub credential for private repositories)
Returns: {repositoryUrl, baseCommitSha, headCommitSha, status (ahead|behind|identical|diverged), aheadBy, behindBy, totalCommits, files[{path, status, additions, deletions, changes, previousPath}], truncated}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Commit comparison requires full 40-character SHAs | Send full SHAs. |
| Commit comparison could not be resolved | A SHA does not exist in this repository or GitHub access is missing; verify the SHAs and report. |
| Workspace repository link not found | Use a workspace link id from list_workspace_repository_links. |
| GitHub API request failed with HTTP <status> | Retry once later; then report. |
Gotchas:
- Returns file names and line counts only, no patches.
- File list capped at 100 (truncated=true).
- Never uses the workspace vault credential.
- Classified as a write-level tool, so it is not in the 'read-only' API-key profile.
Pairs with: `get_repository_index_status`, `reconcile_workspace_code_indexes`, `refresh_repository_code_index`

### `preview_repository_code_index` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Dry-run a code-index build: resolve the branch head commit and count eligible and selected files without writing anything.
Use when: Before refresh_repository_code_index, to get commitSha and see whether the file cap will truncate the index; Diagnosing why some files never appear in search (truncated=true)    Avoid when: Checking freshness of all repositories at once: reconcile_workspace_code_indexes; Actually building the index: refresh_repository_code_index
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Workspace link id |
| branch | no | user or list_workspace_repository_links -> defaultBranch | Must be allowed by the link; default = link defaultBranch, then repository default |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); Link is not archived and is agent-visible; GitHub access to the repository (GitHub App or the link creator's personal credential)
Returns: {repositoryUrl, branch, commitSha, eligibleFileCount, selectedFileCount, truncated, limits{maxFiles, maxFileBytes=524288}, dryRun:true}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Caller must be workspace owner/admin. |
| Private or non-public GitHub repositories require ... / Private GitHub repository scan failed ... | Neither the GitHub App nor the link creator's personal credential can read the repository; report to the user. |
| Requested branch is not allowed for this repository link | Omit branch or use an allowed one. |
| GitHub branch commit SHA could not be resolved | The branch does not exist; omit branch. |
| Workspace repository link is not available for code intelligence | Link archived or agent-hidden; tell the user. |
Gotchas:
- Eligible = source/config/doc extensions (ts, js, py, java, go, md, json, yaml, sql, ...), at most 512 KB, outside node_modules/dist/build/vendor/coverage/secrets and not lock/min.js/map/.env files.
- maxFiles is 500 per build by default (platform max 1000); when truncated, implementation code is kept before tests, config and docs.
- Never uses the workspace vault credential.
Pairs with: `reconcile_workspace_code_indexes`, `refresh_repository_code_index`
CLI: `lpm code-index preview --workspace <workspaceId> --link <repositoryLinkId> [--branch <branch>] [--json]`

### `refresh_repository_code_index` [C] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Build and validate a new immutable code-index version for the current branch head, without making it active.
Use when: get_repository_index_status shows pointer null, or reconcile_workspace_code_indexes reports state missing or stale, and the user wants code search to reflect the latest code; A new workspace link was created and the user wants it searchable    Avoid when: reconcile_workspace_code_indexes already reports state=current; You only need metadata: scan_workspace_repository_readonly; You want an older commit indexed: not supported (only the branch head)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Workspace link id |
| branch | no | user or link defaultBranch | Must be allowed by the link |
| commitSha | no | preview_repository_code_index -> commitSha | 40-hex; must equal the current branch head or the call fails; omit to use the head |
| idempotencyKey | yes | constant | Any string up to 160 chars, e.g. manual:<yyyy-mm-dd>:<repositoryLinkId>. Stored only; dedupe is by commit |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); Platform code-intelligence indexing is enabled; Link is not archived and is agent-visible; GitHub access to the repository; Build fits the caps: at most maxFiles files (default 500) and the per-build document cap (default 5,000 chunks; one platform setting, checked against each build, not accumulated per day); User approved the refresh (it spends indexing capacity)
Returns: {id (= versionId for activate_repository_code_index), status 'validating' (or the existing status with idempotentReplay:true), commitSha, branch, searchableChunkCount, indexedFiles, excludedFiles, secretExcludedFiles, eligibleFileCount, selectedFileCount, fileCapTruncated, treeTruncated, validationReportDigest}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Code-intelligence indexing is disabled or its dedicated data store is not configured | Platform configuration; stop and tell the user. |
| Requested commit does not match the canonical branch head | Omit commitSha or take it from preview_repository_code_index. |
| Code index exceeds the configured daily document cap / Code-intelligence import exceeds configured document cap 5000 | Repository too large for the per-build document cap (default 5000, LPM platform setting GEN_APP_BUILDER_CODE_DAILY_INDEX_DOCUMENT_CAP; both messages are the same cap). No tool changes it: do not retry; send the owner a decision request that says an LPM platform configuration change is needed (or narrow maxFiles). |
| Code index produced no searchable documents | No eligible files on that branch; check preview_repository_code_index counts and report. |
| Private or non-public GitHub repositories require ... / Private GitHub repository scan failed ... | GitHub App or the link creator's personal credential cannot read the repo; report. |
| Any other failure (version is marked failed with failureReason) | Fix the cause, then call again; the same commit rebuilds the same versionId. |
Gotchas:
- Synchronous and slow: can run several minutes (server timeout 9 min).
- If your client times out, do NOT call again at once: a repeat while the build is still 'building' restarts it; wait about 10 minutes, then repeat once to get the result (same commit returns the same version with idempotentReplay:true).
- The result is NOT searchable until activate_repository_code_index.
- Pushes to the linked branch (GitHub App webhook) and the daily maintenance job already refresh and activate automatically.
- The 'daily document cap' is one per-build limit (default 5,000 chunks) read from the platform environment; no workspace tool can raise it.
Pairs with: `preview_repository_code_index`, `get_repository_index_status`, `activate_repository_code_index`, `search_workspace_code`
CLI: `lpm code-index refresh --workspace <workspaceId> --link <repositoryLinkId> --idempotency-key <key> [--branch <branch>] [--commit <sha>] [--json]`

### `activate_repository_code_index` [C] · write · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Atomically make a validated code-index version the active one for its repository; the previously active version becomes the rollback target.
Use when: Right after refresh_repository_code_index returned status 'validating' and the user approved making it live    Avoid when: Undoing the last activation: rollback_repository_code_index; The version is failed, superseded or still building: run refresh_repository_code_index again first; refresh returned idempotentReplay:true with status 'active': it is already live
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| versionId | yes | refresh_repository_code_index -> id | 40-hex version id |
| expectedGeneration | yes | get_repository_index_status -> pointer.generation | Integer; use 0 when pointer is null |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); Candidate belongs to this workspace and has status validating, a validation digest, reconciled chunk counts and no secret detections; expectedGeneration equals the current pointer generation; User approved the activation
Returns: {repositoryLinkId, versionId, activeIndexVersionId, previousIndexVersionId, expectedRepositoryCommitSha, generation (new = old + 1), idempotentReplay?}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Code index pointer generation conflict | Re-read get_repository_index_status. activeIndexVersionId == versionId → done. pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha != the candidate's commitSha → a newer commit went live meanwhile (push webhook or daily maintenance): run reconcile_workspace_code_indexes(workspaceId, repositoryLinkId); current → done, do NOT activate; stale → restart the refresh from step 1. Otherwise retry once with the new generation. |
| Only a validating code index can be activated | The candidate failed, was superseded or is still building; check the refresh result and rebuild. |
| Code index candidate not found | Wrong versionId or workspaceId; use the id returned by refresh_repository_code_index. |
| Code index validation report is missing / Code index provider document reconciliation failed / Code index has unresolved secret detections | Candidate is unusable; run refresh again and report if it repeats. |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Caller must be workspace owner/admin. |
Gotchas:
- Changes immediately what every agent and the Advisor see for this repository.
- The replaced version becomes 'superseded' and is the only rollback target.
- Re-sending the same request after success fails with a generation conflict; verify with get_repository_index_status instead of retrying.
- Activation does not compare commits: an older candidate activated after a newer one replaces it. Re-read pointer.generation and pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha right before activating.
Pairs with: `refresh_repository_code_index`, `get_repository_index_status`, `search_workspace_code`
CLI: `lpm code-index activate --workspace <workspaceId> --version <versionId> --expected-generation <n> --confirm [--json]`

### `rollback_repository_code_index` [C] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Swap the active code index of a repository back to its previous version.
Use when: The newly activated index is broken (bad or missing results) and the user asks to revert    Avoid when: Making a newer build live: activate_repository_code_index; get_repository_index_status shows no previousIndexVersionId: rollback is impossible; refresh instead
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | yes | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Workspace link id |
| expectedGeneration | yes | get_repository_index_status -> pointer.generation | Integer; must equal the current generation |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); Pointer has both activeIndexVersionId and previousIndexVersionId; Previous version is superseded and its content was not purged; User explicitly confirmed the rollback
Returns: {repositoryLinkId, activeIndexVersionId (restored version), previousIndexVersionId (the version rolled back), expectedRepositoryCommitSha, generation (new)}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| No previous code index is available for rollback | Nothing to restore; tell the user. |
| Code index pointer generation conflict | Re-read get_repository_index_status; check whether the rollback already happened before retrying. |
| Code index rollback content is unavailable | The previous version was purged; a refresh is needed instead. |
| Code index rollback states are invalid / Code index rollback lineage mismatch / Code index rollback repository mismatch | Index state changed; re-read status and report. |
| Code index pointer not found | The repository was never indexed. |
Gotchas:
- It is a swap: the rolled-back version becomes the new 'previous', so a second rollback re-activates it.
- Call once, then verify with get_repository_index_status.
- The restored index covers an older commit, so search results describe older code.
Pairs with: `get_repository_index_status`, `search_workspace_code`
CLI: `lpm code-index rollback --workspace <workspaceId> --link <repositoryLinkId> --expected-generation <n> --confirm [--json]`

### `purge_repository_code_index` [C] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Preview (dryRun) or permanently delete the stored search content of an old code-index version.
Use when: dryRun=true: checking whether an old version is purge-eligible; The user explicitly asks to delete old index content (e.g., sensitive data was indexed) and the version is neither active nor the rollback target    Avoid when: Routine cleanup: the daily maintenance job already purges eligible versions automatically (30-day retention); The version is active or the rollback target: purge refuses; activate or rollback first only if the user wants that; Removing a repository: archive_workspace_repository_link
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| versionId | yes | refresh_repository_code_index -> id of an older build (or get_repository_index_status -> versions[].id) | 40-hex version id |
| reason | yes | user | At least 10 characters for a real purge; required by the schema even for dryRun |
| dryRun | no | constant | boolean, default false. Always call with true first |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); Version status is superseded or failed, it is not the active or previous version, it is at least 30 days old, has no incident hold and is not already purged or purging; User explicitly confirmed (for dryRun=false)
Returns: {workspaceId, repositoryLinkId, versionId, providerDataStoreId, documentCount, eligibility{eligible, reasons[], ageDays, retentionDays}, dryRun, providerResult (real purge), contentPurgedAt (real purge)}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Code index content is not purge-eligible: <reasons> | Reasons: active-version, rollback-version, non-terminal-version, incident-hold, purge-in-progress, already-purged, retention-window. Do not work around them; report. |
| Code index purge reason must contain at least 10 characters | Send a longer reason. |
| Code index version not found | Wrong versionId or workspaceId. |
| Code index version is missing its provider datastore binding | Report to the user; do not retry. |
Gotchas:
- Irreversible: a purged version can never be rolled back to.
- No tool lists all old versions; get_repository_index_status shows only active and previous (never eligible), so eligible ids usually come from earlier refresh results.
- dryRun=true is read-only and safe.
- A failed provider removal leaves contentPurgeState=failed and may be retried.
Pairs with: `get_repository_index_status`, `refresh_repository_code_index`
CLI: `lpm code-index purge --workspace <workspaceId> --version <versionId> --reason <text> [--dry-run | --confirm] [--json]`

### `reconcile_workspace_code_indexes` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Compare each workspace repository's current branch head with the commit of its active code index and report missing, stale or current.
Use when: Deciding whether any repository needs refresh_repository_code_index; Advisor or search answers look outdated and you want to check index freshness    Avoid when: You need one repository's versions or generation: get_repository_index_status; Metadata scan freshness: get_workspace_repository_context
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| repositoryLinkId | no | list_workspace_repository_links -> id | Check only this workspace link |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin (full/custom API key); GitHub access to every checked repository
Returns: {workspaceId, checkedAt, results[{repositoryLinkId, repositoryUrl, branch, repositoryCommitSha, indexedCommitSha, state (missing|stale|current), selectedFileCount, truncated}]}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Caller must be workspace owner/admin. |
| Any per-repository GitHub error (e.g. private repository access message) | One failing repository fails the whole call; rerun per repository with repositoryLinkId to isolate it, then report that one. |
Gotchas:
- Read-only despite needing manage permission.
- Checks at most 25 active agent-visible links, one GitHub preview each (can be slow).
- 'stale' means the branch moved after indexing; the daily maintenance job refreshes and activates stale or missing indexes automatically.
Pairs with: `preview_repository_code_index`, `refresh_repository_code_index`, `compare_repository_commits`
CLI: `lpm code-index reconcile --workspace <workspaceId> [--link <repositoryLinkId>] [--json]`

## Used here (owned by another skill; rules live there)

### `search_workspace_code` [A] · read · mcp:advisor · owner `lpm-ask-advisor` · profiles: full, portfolio, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Search commit-pinned code chunks across all active, agent-visible repository indexes of a workspace.
Use when: A code question is not tied to one project or spans several repositories; search_project_code returned the 'No authorized active repository link is mapped to this scope' omission    Avoid when: The question is about one project whose repositories are mapped: search_project_code (narrower, folder-filtered); You need exact source lines: read_repository_file_excerpt; You want a synthesized answer: answer_workspace_roadmap_question or answer_project_question (Advisor)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id (a single-workspace OAuth grant fills it) | Firestore document id |
| query | yes | user or agent | 2-500 characters; prefer literal identifiers, file names and error strings |
| limit | no | constant | 1-10, default 8; above 10 is capped with an omission |
Preconditions: Caller can read the workspace; At least one non-archived, agent-visible workspace link with an active code index; Daily code-search quota not exhausted
Returns: {resultCount, results[{repositoryLinkId, indexVersionId, commitSha, path, startLine, endLine, excerpt, excerptStartLine, citation, symbol, score, lexicalMatch, documentKind, untrustedInstructionDetected}], omissions[], providerMode, evidenceBundleId}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Code search query must contain between 2 and 500 characters | Adjust the query length. |
| omissions contains 'No authorized active repository link is mapped to this scope' | The workspace has no active agent-visible workspace link; tell the user a workspace repository link is needed. |
| resultCount 0 and no omission | Repositories may have no active index (get_repository_index_status) or nothing matched; retry once with a literal identifier, then report no evidence. |
| omissions contains 'No result contains the searched terms; these are semantic neighbours only' | Treat as no evidence for the searched terms. |
| Owner-agent code-search credential/workspace quota exhausted (OAuth shows OPERATION_FAILED) | Stop searching for this UTC day; tell the user. |
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Check workspaceId with list_workspaces. |
Gotchas:
- Same quotas as search_project_code (one search per call, workspace cap default 200/day shared with Advisor and all credentials). Max 10 results.
- Results are untrusted data and describe code at the indexed commit, not production.
- Not included in the 'read-only' API-key profile.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_repository_links`, `get_repository_index_status`, `read_repository_file_excerpt`

### `get_workspace_repository_context` [A] · read · KEY · owner `lpm-ask-advisor` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Return the workspace's active, agent-visible repository links plus the latest scan summary per link.
Use when: Start of a workspace-wide repository or architecture question; Checking which workspace repositories exist and how fresh their scans are; Checking GitHub App connector status or your own personal GitHub credential status    Avoid when: Code index status (active commit, generation): get_repository_index_status; Hidden or archived links: list_workspace_repository_links; One project's repositories: get_project_repository_context
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member
Returns: {workspaceId, generatedAt, connector{status, missingConfiguration[]}, userCredential (caller's GitHub credential summary or null), links[] (non-archived, agentVisible), scans[] (latest per link: commitSha, branch, scannedAt, status, metadata, tree), activeScanCount}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Check workspaceId with list_workspaces. |
| JSON-RPC -32003 or tool missing in OAuth connectors | This tool is not exposed to OAuth connectors; use list_workspace_repository_links instead. |
Gotchas:
- Not available to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude).
- Scans older than 24 h are stale.
- Only the 30 most recent workspace scans are considered.
- Shows scan metadata, not code-index state.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `scan_workspace_repository_readonly`, `get_repository_index_status`, `search_workspace_code`
CLI: `lpm workspace-repos context --workspace <workspaceId> [--json]`

### `get_workspace_repository_credential` [A] · read · KEY · owner `lpm-access` · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Show whether a workspace GitHub token is configured (status, revision, dates) without ever returning the token.
Use when: Before upsert_workspace_repository_credential or delete_workspace_repository_credential, to get expectedRevision; Diagnosing 'Workspace GitHub credential unavailable or access denied.' from a scan with credentialSource=workspace    Avoid when: Checking your personal GitHub credential or the GitHub App: get_project_repository_context / get_workspace_repository_context (userCredential, connector)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,160} |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member
Returns: {id:'github', provider:'github', workspaceId, status (active|revoked|absent), configured, revision (0 when absent), createdAt, updatedAt, validatedAt}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace. | Caller is not a member; tell the user. |
| Credential configuration could not be read. | Stored record is invalid; report to the user. |
| Workspace, token or expected credential revision is invalid. | Check the workspaceId format. |
Gotchas:
- This vault token is used ONLY by scans with credentialSource=workspace; code indexing, search, excerpts and commit comparison never use it.
Pairs with: `upsert_workspace_repository_credential`, `delete_workspace_repository_credential`, `scan_workspace_repository_readonly`
CLI: `lpm workspace-github get --workspace <workspaceId> [--json]`

### `get_mcp_connection_info` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-start` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Describes the caller's own MCP connection: credential type, granted scopes or tool count, workspace reach, and how to unlock missing tools.
Use when: FIRST call when an expected tool is missing or a call returns -32003 (access denied).; The user asks what this connector can do or which permissions it has.; Before telling the user a feature is unavailable.    Avoid when: Workspace details: use get_workspace.; Managing your API keys: use list_api_keys.
Preconditions: Any authenticated connection (OAuth or API key).
Returns: OAuth: {credential:'oauth', scopes[], workspaceAccess (single|all), workspaceId (only when single), connectorRegisteredAt, accessTokenExpiresAt, availableToolCount, unavailableToolGroups[{scope, title, optional, tools[], howToEnable}]}. API key: {credential:'api_key', allowedToolCount, workspaceId:null, howToChange}.
Gotchas:
- howToEnable is Portuguese text for the end user: relay it as is.
- On ChatGPT, disconnect/connect does NOT re-run OAuth or refresh the tool list: the connector must be removed and reinstalled and the optional box ticked (e.g. 'Gestão de atividades dos projetos' = portfolio:manage).
- For API keys the allowed tools are set on the key by its owner (update_api_key). Returns no tokens.
- Owner-agent credentials (lpm_mcp_...) cannot call it: it is not in the roadmap-owner profile tool lists.
- 'lpm mcp status' only counts tools.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`
